GCR runtime packages
====================

The extension bundles @gcr/client-contract 0.1.0-alpha.49,
@gcr/client-core 0.1.0-alpha.50 and @gcr/client-executors 0.1.0-alpha.51
under Apache-2.0. Original notices and license texts are retained.
Immutable source and artifact provenance is recorded in
vendor/gcr/0.1.0-alpha.51/ in the source repository.
